                 (not (holding ?b))

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips :typing)
  (:types normal_block source_block target_block - block)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    (constraint-ok) ; true iff no pending requirement to move block4 after block1
  )

  ; Standard pickup for ordinary blocks
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b - normal_block)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )

  ; Standard putdown for ordinary blocks
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b - normal_block)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)))
  )

  ; Standard stack for ordinary blocks
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b - normal_block ?c - block)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)))
  )

  ; Standard unstack for ordinary blocks
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b - normal_block ?c - block)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )

  ; CONSTRAINT: block1 is source_block; any action that moves block1 sets constraint-ok false.
  ; These actions are the specialized versions of pickup/putdown/stack/unstack for block1.
  (:action pickup-source
    :parameters (?b - source_block)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)) (not (constraint-ok)))
  )
  (:action putdown-source
    :parameters (?b - source_block)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (constraint-ok)))
  )
  (:action stack-source
    :parameters (?b - source_block ?c - block)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)) (not (constraint-ok)))
  )
  (:action unstack-source
    :parameters (?b - source_block ?c - block)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)) (not (constraint-ok)))
  )

  ; CONSTRAINT: block4 is target_block; after moving block4 to a new support, constraint-ok is restored.
  ; Pickup/unstack alone do not clear the obligation; the obligation is cleared when block4 is placed.
  (:action pickup-target
    :parameters (?b - target_block)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )
  (:action putdown-target
    :parameters (?b - target_block)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (constraint-ok))
  )
  (:action stack-target
    :parameters (?b - target_block ?c - block)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)) (constraint-ok))
  )
  (:action unstack-target
    :parameters (?b - target_block ?c - block)

    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )
)

)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    ; CONSTRAINT: static classification for the constrained blocks
    (is-block1 ?b)
    (is-block2 ?b)
    (other ?b)
    ; CONSTRAINT: true iff there is no pending need to move block2 after a block1 move
    (constraint-satisfied)
  )

  ; Standard pickup and unstack are used for ordinary blocks.
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (other ?b) (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))))
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b))))
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c))))
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (other ?b) (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))))

  ; CONSTRAINT: moving block1 clears constraint-satisfied.
  (:action pickup-block1
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (is-block1 ?b) (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))

  ; CONSTRAINT: moving block2 sets constraint-satisfied.
  (:action pickup-block2
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (is-block2 ?b) (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))
                 (constraint-satisfied)))
  ; CONSTRAINT: unstack variants follow the same rule.
  (:action unstack-block1
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (is-block1 ?b) (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))

  )

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
  )

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b))
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)))
  )

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)))
  )

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )
)

`stack` requires holding a block and the target block being clear. The effect is the block is on the target, the arm is empty, and the target is no longer clear.

`unstack` is the reverse of stack. It requires the block to be on another block, clear, and the arm to be empty. The effect is holding the block, the block below is now clear, and the arm is not empty.

The user wants to add a constraint to a PDDL planning problem.
The constraint is: "If you move block1, you must move block2 within the next 2 moves."

This is a state-dependent constraint that needs to be encoded into the PDDL domain.
The core idea is to introduce new predicates to track the state of this obligation.

Let's define the state machine for the constraint:
1.  **Normal state**: No obligation. This is the initial state. Let's call a predicate `(normal)`.
2.  **Obligation triggered**: `block1` has been moved. An obligation to move `block2` is now active. The user said "within the next 2 moves". This means after the move that moves `block1`, we have a 2-move window. Let's call this state `(b2-due-loose)`. The "loose" means we have 2 moves.
3.  **Tight obligation**: One move has passed since the obligation was triggered, and `block2` has not been moved. Now we only have 1 move left. Let's call this state `(b2-due-tight)`.
4.  **Violation**: If another move that is not a `block2` move happens in the `(b2-due-tight)` state, the constraint is violated. We can model this by having no valid actions from this state, causing the planner to fail to find a plan.

So the state transitions are:
-   `Normal` -> `b2-due-loose`: When an action moves `block1`.
-   `b2-due-loose` -> `b2-due-tight`: When any action *not* moving `block2` is performed.
-   `b2-due-loose` -> `Normal`: When an action moves `block2`.
-   `b2-due-tight` -> `Normal`: When an action moves `block2`.
-   `b2-due-tight` -> (dead end): When any action *not* moving `block2` is performed.

chunk_analysis.sound:
The user wants to formalize a Blocks World problem in PDDL.

The problem involves 10 blocks, initially all on the table and clear.
The goal is to achieve a specific final configuration of stacked blocks.

There are two additional constraints on the sequence of moves:
1.  If you move block2, you must move block4 immediately after.
2.  If you move block4, you must move block6 immediately after.

A "move" is considered completed when a block is placed (either stacked on another block or put down on the table). The obligation for the next move is triggered at that point. The obligation is fulfilled when the first action of the next required move (pickup or unstack) is performed.

I will create a PDDL domain file and a PDDL problem file.

**Domain File (`domain.pddl`)**

The domain will be based on the standard Blocks World domain with four actions: `pickup`, `putdown`, `stack`, `unstack`.

To handle the constraints, I will introduce three new predicates:
*   `(requires-next ?x ?y)`: A static predicate indicating that moving block `?x` creates an obligation to move block `?y` next.
*   `(must-move ?x)`: A fluent predicate indicating that there is a pending obligation to move block `?x`.
*   `(no-obligation)`: A fluent predicate (zero-ary) that is true when there are no pending move obligations.

The actions will be modified as follows:

*   **`pickup` and `unstack`**:
    *   Their preconditions will be modified to allow the action only if there is `(no-obligation)` OR if the block being moved (`?b`) is the one that `(must-move ?b)`. This will be a disjunctive precondition `(or (no-obligation) (must-move ?b))`.
    *   Their effects will be modified with a conditional effect: `(when (must-move ?b) (and (not (must-move ?b)) (no-obligation)))`. This consumes the obligation and restores the `no-obligation` state, allowing the move to be completed in the next step.

*   **`stack` and `putdown`**:
    *   Their preconditions will require `(no-obligation)` to be true. This ensures that a new move cannot be completed while an obligation is pending.
    *   Their effects will be modified with a universal conditional effect: `(forall (?n) (when (requires-next ?b ?n) (and (must-move ?n) (not (no-obligation)))))`. When a block `?b` is placed, this checks if there is a `requires-next` rule for it. If so, it sets the new `(must-move ?n)` obligation and sets `(no-obligation)` to false.

**Problem File (`problem.pddl`)**

The problem file will define the 10 blocks as objects.

The initial state (`:init`) will include:
*   All blocks are `(on-table ?b)` and `(clear ?b)`.
*   The arm is `(arm-empty)`.
*   The initial state of the constraint system is `(no-obligation)`.
*   The static constraint rules: `(requires-next block2 block4)` and `(requires-next block4 block6)`.

The goal state (`:goal`) will be the specified final configuration of blocks, AND it will also require `(no-obligation)` to be true, ensuring no outstanding obligations at the end of the plan.

The final configuration is:
*   block10 on block1, block1 on table
*   block8 on block4, block4 on table
*   block2 on block9, block9 on block3, block3 on table
*   block7 on block6, block6 on block5, block5 on table

This setup ensures that any valid plan found by a PDDL planner will respect the given sequential constraints. The planner will have to interleave the required moves correctly. For example, after stacking `block2`, the only valid next action will be to `pickup` or `unstack` `block4`.

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    ;; CONSTRAINT: counter for the number of pick-up actions already used.
    (count-at ?c)
    (next-count ?c ?d)
  )

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b ?c ?d)
    :precondition (and
      (on-table ?b)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      ;; CONSTRAINT: consume one of the allowed 20 pick-ups.
      (count-at ?c)
      (next-count ?c ?d)
    )
    :effect (and
      (holding ?b)
      (not (on-table ?b))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
      ;; CONSTRAINT: advance the pick-up count.
      (not (count-at ?c))
      (count-at ?d)
    )
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and
      (on-table ?b)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
    )
  )

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and
      (holding ?b)
      (clear ?c)
    )
    :effect (and
      (on ?b ?c)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
      (not (clear ?c))
    )
  )

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c ?d ?e)
    :precondition (and
      (on ?b ?c)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      ;; CONSTRAINT: unstacking also picks up a block, so consume one pick-up.
      (count-at ?d)
      (next-count ?d ?e)
    )
    :effect (and
      (holding ?b)
      (clear ?c)
      (not (on ?b ?c))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
      ;; CONSTRAINT: advance the pick-up count.
      (not (count-at ?d))
      (count-at ?e)
    )
  )
)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips :negative-preconditions)
  (:predicates 
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    (forbidden ?x ?y) ;; CONSTRAINT: forbidden stack relation odd ?x on even ?y
  )
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))))
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))))
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b)
                       (clear ?c)
                       (not (forbidden ?b ?c))) ;; CONSTRAINT
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))))
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (clear ?c)
                 (not (on ?b ?c))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))))
)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: A block can only be picked up when it is clear, i.e. no block is on top of it.
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (clear ?b) (on-table ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (clear ?b)) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: putdown places the held block on the table, making it clear and freeing the arm.
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)))
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: stacking requires the held block and a clear destination; only one block can be moved at a time.
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)))
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: unstack moves the clear top block off another block, requiring a clear top and empty arm.
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )
)

Domain string:

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    ;; CONSTRAINT: "Once you stack a block, you cannot unstack it."
    ;; The (unlocked ?x) predicate tracks whether a block may still be
    ;; removed by unstack. Initial stacks are not locked by the constraint.
    (unlocked ?x)
  )

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)))
  )

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
                 ;; CONSTRAINT: after this stack, ?b can never be unstacked.
                 (not (unlocked ?b))
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c)))
  )

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
                       ;; CONSTRAINT: only unlockable blocks may be unstacked.
                       (unlocked ?b))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c)
                 (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )
)

Let's craft domain.

```
(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips :negative-preconditions)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    (fragile ?x) ; CONSTRAINT: marks blocks that cannot support another block
  )
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)))
  )
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (fragile ?c))) ; CONSTRAINT: no block may be placed on a fragile block
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)))
  )
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )
)
```

                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 ; CONSTRAINT: consuming the obligation for ?b (if it exists)
                 (when (must-move ?b)
                   (and (not (must-move ?b)) (no-obligation))))
  )

    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (no-obligation))
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)

                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))

                   (when (requires-next ?b ?n)
                     (and (must-move ?n) (not (no-obligation)))))
                 )
  )

    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (no-obligation))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))
                 ; CONSTRAINT: completing a move of ?b may create the next obligation
                 (forall (?n)
                   (when (requires-next ?b ?n)
                     (and (must-move ?n) (not (no-obligation)))))
                 )
  )

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)

                 (not (on ?b ?c))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))

)

(define (domain blocksworld)

  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)

    (requires-next ?x ?y)
    (must-move ?x)
    (no-obligation)
    ; CONSTRAINT-END
  )

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
                       ; CONSTRAINT: if an obligation is pending, only the required block may be picked up
                       (or (no-obligation) (must-move ?b)))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 ; CONSTRAINT: satisfy/consume a pending obligation for ?b
                 (when (must-move ?b)
                   (and (not (must-move ?b)) (no-obligation))))
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (no-obligation))
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 ; CONSTRAINT: completing a move of ?b may create the next obligation
                 (forall (?n)
                   (when (requires-next ?b ?n)
                     (and (must-move ?n) (not (no-obligation)))))
                 )
  )

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (no-obligation))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))
                 ; CONSTRAINT: completing a move of ?b may create the next obligation
                 (forall (?n)
                   (when (requires-next ?b ?n)
                     (and (must-move ?n) (not (no-obligation)))))
                 )
  )

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
                       ; CONSTRAINT: if an obligation is pending, only the required block may be picked up
                       (or (no-obligation) (must-move ?b)))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (clear ?c)
                 (not (on ?b ?c))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 ; CONSTRAINT: satisfy/consume a pending obligation for ?b
                 (when (must-move ?b)
                   (and (not (must-move ?b)) (no-obligation))))
  )
)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates (on ?x ?y) (on-table ?x) (clear ?x) (holding ?x) (arm-empty))
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (clear ?b) (on-table ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (not (clear ?b)) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (arm-empty)) (holding ?b)))
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (clear ?b) (on-table ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b))))
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (not (clear ?c)) (not (holding ?b)) (clear ?b) (on ?b ?c) (arm-empty)))
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)) (clear ?c) (holding ?b)))
)

chunk_analysis.sound:
The user wants me to formalize a PDDL problem.
The problem is a variation of the classic Blocksworld domain.
The key constraint is: "Once you stack a block, you cannot unstack it."

This implies that the `unstack` action should be conditional. A block that has been placed on another block via a `stack` action becomes "locked" and cannot be the object of a subsequent `unstack` action. Blocks that are in a tower in the initial state were not placed there by a `stack` action, so they are not "locked" and can be unstacked.

To model this, I will introduce a new predicate: `(unlocked ?b)`.
- Initially, all blocks will have the `(unlocked ?b)` predicate set to true.
- The `stack(?b, ?c)` action will have an effect `(not (unlocked ?b))`. This means block `?b` is now locked.
- The `unstack(?b, ?c)` action will have a precondition `(unlocked ?b)`. This means a block can only be unstacked if it is still unlocked.

The rest of the domain definition will be standard Blocksworld.

Let's break down the initial and goal states from the problem description.

Initial state:
- 6 blocks: block1, block2, block3, block4, block5, block6.
- Block 3 is on top of Block 4. Block 4 is on the table. -> `(on block3 block4)`, `(on-table block4)`, `(clear block3)`.
- Block 2 is on top of Block 6. Block 6 is on the table. -> `(on block2 block6)`, `(on-table block6)`, `(clear block2)`.
- Block 1 is on the table. -> `(on-table block1)`, `(clear block1)`.
- Block 5 is on the table. -> `(on-table block5)`, `(clear block5)`.
- The arm is empty. -> `(arm-empty)`.
- All blocks are initially unlocked. -> `(unlocked block1)`, `(unlocked block2)`, `(unlocked block3)`, `(unlocked block4)`, `(unlocked block5)`, `(unlocked block6)`.

Goal state:
- Block 4 on top of Block 3. -> `(on block4 block3)`.
- Block 3 on the table. -> `(on-table block3)`.
- Block 1 on the table. -> `(on-table block1)`.
- Block 2 on the table. -> `(on-table block2)`.
- Block 5 on the table. -> `(on-table block5)`.
- Block 6 on the table. -> `(on-table block6)`.

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    (placeable ?x) ; CONSTRAINT: true while a block has never been picked up
  )

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (not (placeable ?b))) ; CONSTRAINT: once picked up, it cannot be put down
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (placeable ?b)) ; CONSTRAINT: only blocks never picked up can be put down
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b)))
  )

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (placeable ?b)) ; CONSTRAINT: stacking would put the held block down
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c)))
  )

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (clear ?c)
                 (not (on ?b ?c))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (not (placeable ?b))) ; CONSTRAINT: unstacking also picks up the block, so placing is forbidden afterwards
  )
)
```

    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)

    (ok-stack-count ?n)
    (next-count ?low ?high)
    (prev-count ?high ?low)

    :parameters (?b ?old ?new)
    :precondition (and
      (on-table ?b)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (stack-count ?old)
      (ok-stack-count ?old)
      (prev-count ?old ?new)
      (ok-stack-count ?new)
    )
    :effect (and
      (holding ?b)
      (not (on-table ?b))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
      (not (stack-count ?old))
      (stack-count ?new)
    )
  )
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b ?low ?high)
    :precondition (and
      (holding ?b)
      (stack-count ?low)
      (next-count ?low ?high)
      (ok-stack-count ?high)
    )
    :effect (and
      (on-table ?b)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
      (not (stack-count ?low))
      (stack-count ?high)
    )
  )
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c ?n)
    :precondition (and
      (holding ?b)
      (clear ?c)
      (stack-count ?n)
      (ok-stack-count ?n)
    )
    :effect (and
      (on ?b ?c)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
      (not (clear ?c))
    )
  )
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c ?n)
    :precondition (and
      (on ?b ?c)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (stack-count ?n)
      (ok-stack-count ?n)

    :effect (and

- `(holding ?x)`: the arm is holding block ?x.
- `(arm-empty)`: the arm is holding nothing.

The actions are:
- `pickup(?b)`: pick up a block ?b from the table.
- `putdown(?b)`: put down a block ?b onto the table.

The user wants me to solve a scheduling problem.
The problem is to find a valid ordering of tasks for a single worker, given a set of tasks with release times and deadlines.

The completion time of a task in a sequence is the sum of the durations of all preceding tasks plus its own duration.
For a sequence of tasks to be valid, for each task Ti in the sequence, its completion time C(Ti) must be less than or equal to its deadline D(Ti), and its start time S(Ti) must be greater than or equal to its release time R(Ti). The start time S(Ti) is the completion time of the previous task in the sequence (or 0 if it's the first task).

)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    (heavier ?x ?y)
  )
  ; CONSTRAINT: (heavier ?x ?y) means block ?x is heavier than block ?y.
  ; The stack action requires the bottom block to be heavier than the top block,
  ; so heavier blocks are never stacked on lighter blocks.

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (clear ?b) (on-table ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (clear ?b)) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (clear ?b) (on-table ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)))
  )

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (heavier ?c ?b)) ; bottom ?c must be heavier than top ?b
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)))
  )

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )
)
```

Domain:
(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates (on ?x ?y) (on-table ?x) (clear ?x) (holding ?x) (arm-empty))
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (clear ?b) (on-table ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (clear ?b)) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (arm-empty))))
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (on-table ?b) (not (holding ?b))))
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c))))
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))))
Note: For stack, effect includes (clear ?b) because after placing b on c, b is clear. It also includes (not (clear ?c)) because c blocked. It includes (not (holding ?b)) and (arm-empty). It doesn't explicitly say not on-table ?b? Since b was held, not on-table already. Fine.

For pickup, effect (holding ?b), not clear, not on-table, not arm-empty. Fine.

For putdown, effect clear b, arm-empty, on-table b, not holding. Fine.

For unstack, effect holding b, clear c, not on b c, not clear b, not arm-empty. Fine.
